rows.label: TOURNAMENT

rows.label: TWIST

rows.label: SACK RACE

rows.label: MESHING
rows.clue: Contact by fitting together

rows.label: EPISODE

rows.label: WAVE

rows.label: TRACK MEET

rows.label: FINAL RESULT
rows.clue: Something that results

rows.label: WHIRL
rows.clue: Confused movement

rows.label: DECATHLON

rows.label: SCRATCH RACE
rows.clue: A race in which all contestants start from scratch (on equal terms)

rows.label: BREAK

rows.label: DEBRIS STORM
rows.clue: The sudden spread of dust and debris from a collapsing building

rows.label: DIVING EVENT

rows.label: WILDFIRE

rows.label: CRACKING
rows.clue: A sudden sharp noise

rows.label: SCRUNCH

rows.label: EAGER

rows.label: SIDESWIPE

rows.label: SUBLIMATION

rows.label: INGRESS
rows.clue: (astronomy) the disappearance of a celestial body prior to an eclipse

rows.label: TRAGEDY

rows.label: WOBBLE

rows.label: PEEP

rows.label: TIDAL WAVE

rows.label: GOOD TIME

rows.label: SIDESHOW

rows.label: TRIUMPH

rows.label: RAW DEAL
rows.clue: Unfair treatment

rows.label: ATAVISM

rows.label: SPRITZ

rows.label: TOUCH
rows.clue: The event of something coming in contact with the body

rows.label: RUNOFF
rows.clue: The occurrence of surplus liquid (as water) exceeding the limit or capacity

rows.label: HAPPENING

rows.label: MISCARRIAGE

rows.label: DISSIPATION

rows.label: YELP

rows.label: GRUNT

rows.label: VISITATION

rows.label: SPREAD

rows.label: HURDLING

rows.label: HEARTBEAT

rows.label: SCRATCHING

rows.label: WALTZ

rows.label: DIRECT TIDE
rows.clue: The occurrence of high tide on one side of the earth coinciding with high tide on the opposite side

rows.label: VIBRATO

rows.label: INDUCTION

rows.label: GROUND LOOP
rows.clue: A sharp uncontrollable turn made by an airplane while moving along the ground

rows.label: BANGING
rows.clue: A continuing very loud noise

rows.label: POTATO RACE
rows.clue: A novelty race in which competitors move potatoes from one place to another one at a time

rows.label: WATER HAMMER
rows.clue: The banging sound of steam in pipes

rows.label: FIRE
rows.clue: The event of something burning (often destructive)

rows.label: TIME
rows.clue: An instance or single occasion for some event

rows.label: OMEGA
rows.clue: The ending of a series or sequence

rows.label: JANGLE
rows.clue: A metallic sound

rows.label: CLIMAX
rows.clue: The highest point of anything conceived of as growing or developing or unfolding

rows.label: HOME STAND
rows.clue: A series of successive games played at a team's home field or court

rows.label: RESILIENCY
rows.clue: An occurrence of rebounding or springing back

rows.label: GROUND SWELL
rows.clue: An obvious change of public opinion or political sentiment that occurs without leadership or overt expression

rows.label: BONFIRE
rows.clue: A large outdoor fire that is lighted as a signal or in celebration

rows.label: CLAP
rows.clue: A sudden very loud noise

rows.label: FUNDAMENTAL
rows.clue: Any factor that could be considered important to the understanding of a particular business

rows.label: DOG RACING
rows.clue: A race between dogs

rows.label: STANDOFF
rows.clue: The finish of a contest in which the score is tied and the winner is undecided

rows.label: VICISSITUDE
rows.clue: A variation in circumstances or fortune at different times in your life or in the development of something

rows.label: RIP CURRENT
rows.clue: A strong surface current flowing outwards from a shore

rows.label: SLACK TIDE
rows.clue: The occurrence of relatively still water at the turn of the (low) tide

rows.label: GOING UNDER
rows.clue: (of a ship) sinking

rows.label: CONVERGENCE
rows.clue: The occurrence of two or more things coming together

rows.label: ROUND ROBIN
rows.clue: A tournament in which every contestant plays every other contestant

rows.label: BANG
rows.clue: A vigorous blow

rows.label: BLEAT
rows.clue: The sound of sheep or goats (or any sound resembling this)

rows.label: LAST LAUGH
rows.clue: Ultimate success achieved after a near failure (inspired by the saying `he laughs best who laughs last')

rows.label: BRAWL
rows.clue: An uproarious party

rows.label: COTILLION
rows.clue: A ball at which young ladies are presented to society

rows.label: DECREASE
rows.clue: A change downward

rows.label: FLASHING
rows.clue: A short vivid experience

rows.label: GROUND NOISE
rows.clue: Extraneous noise contaminating sound measurements that cannot be separated from the desired signal

rows.label: SHRILLING
rows.clue: A continuing shrill noise

rows.label: DEFEAT
rows.clue: An unsuccessful ending to a struggle or contest

rows.label: DESERTS
rows.clue: An outcome (good or bad) that is well deserved

rows.label: MAELSTROM
rows.clue: A powerful circular current of water (usually the result of conflicting tides)

rows.label: SQUISH
rows.clue: The noise of soft mud being walked on

rows.label: IMPROVEMENT
rows.clue: A change for the better

rows.label: BUST
rows.clue: A complete failure

rows.label: TWINKLE
rows.clue: A rapid change in brightness

rows.label: SWELL
rows.clue: The undulating movement of the surface of the open sea

rows.label: RISE
rows.clue: A growth in strength or number or importance

rows.label: WHAMMY
rows.clue: A serious or devastating setback

rows.label: LIFTOFF
rows.clue: The initial ascent of a rocket from its launching pad

rows.label: BICYCLE RACE
rows.clue: A race between people riding bicycles

rows.label: ROLLING WAVE
rows.clue: A long heavy sea wave as it advances towards the shore

rows.label: CHIRP
